# Biology Corner

> A comprehensive resource hub for high school biology teachers featuring worksheets, labs, case studies, and hands-on activities aligned with modern biology curriculum standards.

Biology Corner provides educators with ready-to-use classroom materials spanning core biology topics including cell biology, genetics, evolution, ecology, and anatomy. The site emphasizes inquiry-based learning through case studies, forensic mysteries, and laboratory investigations that engage students in authentic scientific practice.

## Key Topics

- High School Biology
- Lab Activities
- Case Studies
- Cell Biology
- DNA & Genetics
- Punnett Squares
- Gel Electrophoresis
- Forensics
- Evolution & Taxonomy
- Hands-on Investigation
- Lesson Plans
- Classroom Resources
- AP Biology
- Cell Cycle
- Enzymes

## Core Lesson Plans

- [Teaching Resources for Cell Biology and Cytology](https://www.biologycorner.com/lesson-plans/cells): Cell biology worksheets covering plant, animal, and bacteria cells
- [Classroom Resources for Teaching Genetics and DNA](https://www.biologycorner.com/lesson-plans/genetics): Genetics worksheets including Punnett squares and Mendelian inheritance
- [Animal Anatomy, Dissection Guides, and Labeling Practice](https://www.biologycorner.com/lesson-plans/anatomy): Dissection guides and labeling exercises for animal anatomy
- [Evolution & Taxonomy](https://www.biologycorner.com/lesson-plans/evolution-taxonomy): Evolution and taxonomy lesson plans with case studies and simulations
- [Ecology Teaching Resources](https://www.biologycorner.com/lesson-plans/ecology): Ecology resources on populations, biomes, and community interactions
- [Engaging Activities Exploring the Scientific Method](https://www.biologycorner.com/lesson-plans/scientific-method): Scientific method activities and lab exercises for high school biology

## Forensics & DNA Case Studies

- [Who Ate the Cheese? A Gel Electrophoresis Simulation](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/03/01/who-ate-the-cheese-a-gel-electrophoresis-simulation): Gel electrophoresis forensic mystery activity with DNA fingerprinting
- [The Case of the Finch Flair: A DNA Mystery](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/03/14/the-case-of-the-finch-flair-a-dna-mystery): DNA mystery case study analyzing SNP data and pedigree charts
- [The Honey Badger Heist – Blood and Forensics](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/02/22/the-honey-badge-heist-blood-and-forensics): Blood typing forensic lab using ABO system and agglutination

## Hands-On Laboratory Investigations

- [Investigation – Root Growth and Cell Division](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/02/15/investigation-root-growth-and-cell-division): Plant hormone lab exploring auxin, mitosis, and root growth
- [Lab – Comparing Human and Frog Blood Cells](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/01/25/a-chilling-case-study-raining-iguanas): Microscopy lab comparing human and frog blood cell differences

## Evolution & Biology Concepts

- [Teaching Evolution: The Case of the Fanged Frog](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/03/07/teaching-evolution-the-case-of-the-fanged-frog): Evolution case study on speciation and gene flow using fanged frog
- [When Iguanas Rain From the Sky: Teaching Homeostasis](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/01/25/a-chilling-case-study-raining-iguanas): Homeostasis case study using iguanas and ectothermy concepts
- [Why Don't Elephants Get Cancer? – Peto's Paradox](https://www.biologycorner.com/2026/01/11/why-dont-elephants-get-cancer-petos-paradox): Peto's Paradox case study on p53, tumor suppressors, and cancer

## Introductory Courses

- [Introduction to Biology](https://www.biologycorner.com/introbio/index.html): Introductory biology course site with slides, notes, and NGSS-aligned labs
